foodForest.title: Soft citrus
lines: Tse teng: 1; tse rerilweng: 1. Dihlahiswa: ditholwana.
Nako ya kotulo ya pele: ha e a fumanwa mohloding; o se ke wa itshetleha ka dimela tse sa tswa jalwa bakeng sa dijo hanghang.
Ditholwana tsa citrus tse bonolo hangata e rata maemo a phodileng, a ommeng. Netefatsa ditlhoko tsa kutu ya motso le ho tsamaisa peo/ho ba le dipeo pele o kopanya mefuta.

Keletso ya ho reka: Bakeng sa sebaka se loketseng: Miho Wase satsuma ya pele (ho tloha bohareng ba Hlakubele); clementines tsa bohareng (mafelong a Hlakubele–bohareng ba Phupjane); Nadorcott mandarin ya morao (bohareng ba Motsheanong–Leotshe). Matsatsi ke ditshupiso tse batsi tsa Afrika Borwa, ha se khalendara ya lehae. Odara difate tsa keretjhe tse nang le dileibole.
Nako ya kotulo e lebeletsweng: ha ho nako e le nngwe e tiisitsweng ya mofuta wa sebaka. Dinako tsa ditshupiso tse ka tlase ha se ponelopele.

lines: Tse teng: 1; tse rerilweng: 1. Dihlahiswa: ditholwana.

foodForest.title: Low-chill peach
lines: Tse teng: 1; tse rerilweng: 1. Dihlahiswa: ditholwana.

Tshupiso ya kotulo ya pele: dilemo tse 3. Tataiso e akaretsang ya diperekisi ya KZN; karolo ena e supa dikgohlo tsa dinoka tsa Muden, Middelrus le Weenen e le dibaka tsa ho lema tse hlokang mohatsela o monyenyane. Netefatsa mofuta le dilemo tsa ho qala sethopong. Nako ya nnete e itshetlehile ka mofuta le tlhokomelo ya sebaka.

Tshupiso ya tlhahiso e tsitsitseng: dilemo tse 7. Tataiso yona eo ya sebaka e hlalosa bophelo ba serapa sa ditholwana sa kgwebo ba hoo e ka bang dilemo tse 12–15; ha e fane ka chai ya sefate ka seng ho ya ka dilemo.

Tshupiso ya tlhahiso: 23–43 kg/semela. HO FETOTSWE, palo e bontshitswe: ho nkilwe sehlopha sa chai sa “Average” (15-18 t/ha) le sebaka pakeng tsa dimela se boletsweng mohloding wona oo (“Generally planted 6m x 4m or 5 m x 3 m”). Ho 6x4m = 24 m²/tree → 10000/24 = 416.7 trees/ha → 15000kg/416.7=36.0 le 18000kg/416.7=43.2 kg/tree. Ho 5x3m = 15 m²/tree → 666.7 trees/ha → 15000/666.7=22.5 le 18000/666.7=27.0 kg/tree. Moedi o kopantsweng wa dibaka tseo ka bobedi, o potolohisitsweng: [23, 43] kg/tree. Phapang ena e bontsha dibaka tse pedi tse fapaneng tse fumanweng mohloding, e seng phapang ya mefuta.
Netefatsa ho bata ho hlokwang ke mofuta o itseng le kotsi ya leqhwa nakong ya selemo. Mocheso o mahareng wa mariha ha se tekanyo ya dihora tsa ho bata.

Keletso ya ho reka: Mofuta o ka nahanelwang o hlokang ho bata ho fokolang ho isa ho mahareng: Earligold (200–400 Infruitec units), o nang le tshupiso ya ho qala ho kga ka Tshitwe e tswang Bien Donne, Western Cape. Cederberg ya morao e na le tshupiso ya Pherekgong. Netefatsa ho bata ha nnete, dimela le matsatsi a lehae pele o hlophisa tatellano ya mefuta.
Ho tsamaiswa ha peo ya dipalesa: e ka behang ditholwana ka peo ya yona ya dipalesa. Hlahloba ditlhoko tsa mofuta o kgethilweng le sebaka sa kgodiso ya dimela.
Nako ya kotulo e lebeletsweng: ha ho nako e le nngwe e tiisitsweng ya mofuta wa sebaka. Dinako tsa ditshupiso tse ka tlase ha se ponelopele.
Tshupiso feela — South Africa — mofuta wa Earligold o hlokang ho bata ho honyane (low-chill) (o hlahisitswe ke ARC Infruitec-Nietvoorbij, dibaka tsa temo tse nang le ho bata ho honyane): Tsh.
Tshupiso feela — South Africa — mefuta ya Cederberg le Afrisun e hlokang ho bata ho honyane/ha mahareng (low/medium-chill) (e hlahisitswe ke ARC Infruitec-Nietvoorbij): Phe.

lines: Tse teng: 1; tse rerilweng: 1. Dihlahiswa: ditholwana.
Nako ya kotulo ya pele: ha e a fumanwa mohloding; o se ke wa itshetleha ka dimela tse sa tswa jalwa bakeng sa dijo hanghang.

Flame Seedless year 4 — Hex River Valley enterprise budget: Year 4 commercial budget: 4,400 cartons/ha at 4.5 kg/carton = 19,800 kg/ha. The source does not provide matched vines/ha or row/vine spacing, so no kg/vine is derived. This is a budget assumption for one cultivar and region, not a generic full-bearing age or a local mapped-vine production record.
Nyalanya mofuta wa serapa sa morara le sebaka sa tlhahiso, metsi le tsamaiso ya tshehetso. Nako ya phepelo ya naha e kopanya dibaka tse mmalwa.

Keletso ya ho reka: Tshupiso ya indasteri ya DAFF: Prime Seedless, Sugraone le Flame Seedless tsa pele; Dauphine le Crimson Seedless tsa morao. SATI e bolela dikgetho tsa Orange River tse kenyelletsang Prime, Thompson Seedless le Sugraone. Netefatsa matsatsi le dimela tsa lehae; tatellano ya indasteri ha se khalendara ya polasi ya KZN.
Ho tsamaiswa ha peo ya dipalesa: e ka behang ditholwana ka peo ya yona ya dipalesa. Hlahloba ditlhoko tsa mofuta o kgethilweng le sebaka sa kgodiso ya dimela.
Nako ya kotulo e lebeletsweng: ha ho nako e le nngwe e tiisitsweng ya mofuta wa sebaka. Dinako tsa ditshupiso tse ka tlase ha se ponelopele.
